_note: Published atmosphere detections for the Planets tab (Milestone 4). Only molecules a paper reports as detected; disputed claims are listed under 'disputed'. Names match the NASA Exoplanet Archive's pl_name. Compiled 2026-11-15.

WASP-39 b.summary: A hot (about 1,100 K) Saturn-mass gas giant. JWST found water, CO₂, CO and the first sulfur dioxide seen on an exoplanet, made by starlight-driven chemistry.

references.label: Powell et al. 2024, Nature 626, 979 (SO₂ with MIRI)

K2-18 b.summary: A sub-Neptune in its star's habitable zone. JWST detected methane and CO₂; an earlier water-vapour claim from Hubble is now thought to be methane, and whether it has an ocean is debated.
